title: Regional traffic rehome and KV-consistency hotfix for hosted + dedicated tenants
creator: Asha Raman
description: Several customers reported elevated 5xx errors and request timeouts during a partial-cloud-region degradation. Root cause analysis shows an interaction between region-level traffic steering and our KV prefix cache rehydration path: when tenant routing was shifted off the degraded region, some long-lived shard leases and local KV entries did not rehydrate correctly in the target region, causing transient deserialization errors and increased latency. This ticket covers a short-term hotfix (automated rehome with synchronous KV rehydrate), the runbook to drive manual migration for high priority tenants, and a durable runtime change to prevent future divergence.
acceptance_criteria: Automated rehome tool can move tenant slices from one region to another with less than 1 minute of error elevation for affected requests
KV cache invalidation + rehydration completes for rehomed tenants before traffic is fully routed (no 500s caused by missing schema/keys)
Staged runbook validated end-to-end in staging and in one nonprofit customer's dedicated pool
Monitoring alerts: synthetic end-to-end latency + 5xx rate baseline restored within SLOs during a traffic shift simulation
Customer communications template and escalation flow documented and approved by Support and Solutions
reproduction_steps: Provision two region test cluster: region-a and region-b with same model version and runtime-1.19.2
Deploy a tenant with sticky shard assignment to region-a and warm the KV prefix cache with a 30m session
Induce routing weight drop on region-a (simulate outage) and trigger automated traffic rehoming to region-b
Observe KV rehydrate path: watch for missing keys / schema mismatch logs in region-b and increased 5xxs for requests that rely on cached schema
Capture runtime logs and kernel scheduling traces for affected requests (trace-id header)
mitigation_steps: Immediate: enable emergency traffic-shepherd (weight decouple) to avoid simultaneous half-switchover between regions
Run temporary KV-ttl-reset job on target region immediately after routing change to force synchronous rehydrate for tenant prefixes
If errors persist for a customer: perform manual tenant rehome with live proxy drain (steps in runbook) and escalate to Solutions for live customer updates
Push a quick runtime patch that gates traffic cutover until KV rehydrate ack is returned (hotfix branch)
Notify on-call ENG and Support; open customer-specific incident threads and set expected ETAs
runbook_snippet: 1) Identify affected tenant slice IDs via live-metrics dashboard. 2) Run 'traffic-rehome --slice <id> --target-region <region-b> --dry-run' and review plan. 3) Trigger KV rehydrate job: 'kv-rehydrate --slice <id> --blocking'. 4) Verify rehydrate success in target region logs and synthetic probe (trace-id). 5) Flip live routing weight to target region in 10% increments with 2-minute stablization windows. 6) If 5xx > baseline + 3 sigma, pause and rollback using 'traffic-rehome --rollback <id>'. 7) Post-action: capture debug bundle and annotate incident ticket.
